one_liner_zh: Meta 營收年增近三成表現強勁，但每股盈餘因成本增加低於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Meta reported strong revenue growth near 30% YoY, but EPS missed estimates due to rising costs.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期，每股盈餘 6.18 美元低於市場預期的 7.22 美元。
highlights_zh: 季度總營收達到 608 億美元，較去年同期顯著成長 27.96%。
核心廣告業務與應用程式家族維持穩健的用戶參與度與營收動能。
人工智慧技術持續深化應用於廣告投放與內容推薦系統。
highlights_en: Total quarterly revenue reached $60.80B, representing a strong 27.96% increase year-over-year.
Core advertising business and family of apps maintained solid user engagement and revenue momentum.
Artificial intelligence technologies continue to deepen integration into ad targeting and content recommendation.
risks_zh: 資本支出與營運成本上升對短期獲利能力造成壓力。
總體經濟環境變動可能影響廣告主未來行銷預算。
AI 基礎設施投資的回報週期拉長可能引發市場疑慮。
risks_en: Rising capital expenditures and operating costs exert pressure on near-term profitability.
Macroeconomic volatility could impact future advertising budgets of enterprise clients.
Extended payback periods on AI infrastructure investments may raise market concerns.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：營收強勁但獲利不如預期顯示成本壓力浮現。對短中期股價可能偏向震盪整理，須密切追蹤未來資本支出效率與廣告營收成長的續航力。
ai_view_en: view: Strong revenue coupled with an EPS miss highlights mounting cost pressures. Near-to-mid-term stock performance may remain volatile; investors should closely track capital expenditure efficiency and advertising revenue sustainability.
